entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The continent of Dominaria where Scourge is set, poisoned by mana from the Mirari.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Otaria lies.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: A destructive avatar of all five colors of mana formed by the fusion of Phage and Akroma.

entities.name: Phage the Untouchable
entities.description: The undead form of Jeska, who fought Akroma and fused into Karona upon death.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: Combatant in the war with Phage whose death and fusion helped form Karona.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Kamahl's sister, freed from Karona and Phage, and a planeswalker according to Karn.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Jeska's brother, who frees her from Karona and Phage.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker who returns to Otaria to take Jeska to Argentum and who forged Memnarch.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: A golem forged by Karn from the Mirari and guardian of the plane Argentum.

entities.name: Argentum
entities.description: A plane that Karn substantially shaped.

entities.name: The Mirari
entities.description: Source of profuse mana that poisons Otaria and from which Memnarch was forged.

entities.name: Sliver Overlord
entities.description: A new leader of the slivers, born from the explosion that spawned Karona, controlling others via the hive mind.

entities.name: Karona's War
entities.description: The conflict on Otaria in which militant factions seek to claim Karona.

entities.name: Apocalypse
entities.description: Devastating events on Dominaria that Otaria was mostly spared from.

events.summary: Phage and Akroma's war ends with their deaths and fusion into Karona, leaving Otaria torn by militant factions.
events.quote: With the vicious war between Phage and Akroma , and their followers, over with their deaths and fusion into Karona

events.summary: The explosion that spawned Karona also gives birth to the Sliver Overlord.
events.quote: from the explosion that spawned Karona, the Sliver Overlord , a new leader of the slivers, controlling others via the hive mind, was born

events.summary: Kamahl frees his sister Jeska from Karona and Phage.
events.quote: Kamahl frees his sister, Jeska , from both Karona and Phage

events.summary: Karn returns to Otaria to take Jeska to Argentum.
events.quote: Karn returns to Otaria, Dominaria, to take her to Argentum

events.summary: Karn tells Jeska she is a planeswalker and asks her to travel the multiverse with him.
events.quote: Karn intimates that Jeska is a planeswalker and beseeches her to travel the multiverse as his companion.

events.summary: Karn shows Jeska Memnarch, the golem he forged from the Mirari.
events.quote: until Karn informs and shows her Memnarch

relations.quote: a golem that he forged from the Mirari and the guardian of the plane
